title: Globe Registry: Globe® Pulsed Field System Registry Study for Treating Patients With Symptomatic Atrial Fibrillation
official: Globe Registry: Globe® Pulsed Field System Registry Study for Treating Patients With Symptomatic Atrial Fibrillation
summary: This post-market registry is designed to collect real world data on the use of the Globe PF System for the treatment of atrial fibrillation (AF).
criteria:
Key Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with a planned ablation procedure using the commercially available Globe PF System

Key Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients whose life expectancy is 1 year or less
* Contraindication to left atrial catheter ablation or PF ablation
* Current enrollment in any investigational study of a medical device, biologic, or drug not pre-approved by Kardium
